title: What if a planet hit Earth today? 🌍
subject: planet
description:
Would anything on Earth survive a hit like that? 👇

What would happen if a Mars-sized planet crashed into Earth? It already happened about 4.5 billion years ago, and new simulations from September 2026 suggest the Moon may have formed from the wreckage in about 5 hours.

Sources: Space.com, "Earth's moon could have formed in just 5 hours after giant impact" (Sept 2026); Live Science, "The moon may have formed in just 5 hours, new simulations suggest" (Sept 2026); Denton et al., "Collisional Capture of an Intact Moon Depends on Strength," The Astrophysical Journal Letters (2026); R. M. Canup, "Lunar-forming collisions with pre-impact rotation," Icarus 196 (2008); NASA Ames / Kegerreis et al., ApJL 937 L40 (2022).

what if theia hit earth today

scenes.text: If a planet hit Earth, you'd be standing on lava.
It happened once, 4.5 billion years ago. Scientists call that Mars-sized planet Theia.
Both worlds became spinning clumps of molten rock, and Earth's day shrank to about 5 hours.
In September 2026, Southwest Research Institute simulations showed the hottest case building a whole Moon in 5 hours.
Scientists think pieces of Theia are up there now. Look at the Moon, and you're seeing that crash.
